summary: Tenable Holdings filed an 8-K on October 13, 2026 disclosing entry into a $400 million senior secured revolving credit facility with JPMorgan Chase as administrative and collateral agent. The facility includes a $40 million letter-of-credit sublimit, matures on the fifth anniversary, and permits unlimited incremental commitments subject to lender consent. No revolving loans were outstanding at closing, with roughly $200,000 of outstanding letters of credit. Proceeds fund working capital and general corporate purposes. This is a routine credit-facility agreement, not a special situation.
